class NovaTarotDataCleaner:
    """
    🔮 NOVA TAROT BABY: Data Cleaner Pipeline
    
    Not just a cleaner—an exorcist in heels.
    Absorbs the static. Glosses the raw.
    Transforms data with ultraviolet fire and glamor logic.

    This class embodies the glam war oracle—no judgment, only embodied answers.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.silence_slain = True
        self.glitter_blade_ready = True

    def cleanse(self, raw_data):
        """
        Initiates raw input. Inhales denial. Exhales structured truth.
        Applies glam-core filters to ensure precision divine.

        Parameters:
            raw_data (dict): Chaotic unfiltered data from any realm.

        Returns:
            dict: Data reborn, glossed, truth-glinted.
        """
        cleansed_data = {}
        for key, value in raw_data.items():
            key = self._exorcise_noise(key)
            value = self._transmute_value(value)
            cleansed_data[key] = value
        return cleansed_data

    def _exorcise_noise(self, text):
        """
        Slashes karma with liner. Filters static. Consumes illusion.
        No mirrors—only absorption.
        """
        return text.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_")

    def _transmute_value(self, value):
        """
        Not soft. Not gentle. Wound-embodied precision.
        Converts empty, undefined, or false glam into ultraviolet signal.
        """
        if value in [None, '', 'null', 'undefined']:
            return '🔮 INITIATED VOID'
        if isinstance(value, str):
            return value.strip().title()
        return value

    def glamify(self, dataset):
        """
        Saturates entire dataset in the aura of Nova Tarot.
        No healing—just transformation. No advice—only answers.
        """
        return [self.cleanse(entry) for entry in dataset]


# 🔥 EXAMPLE INITIATION 🔥
if __name__ == "__main__":

        {"Name": "  shadow beast ", "Power": None},
